definitions.explanation: The state of being confused or at a loss about how to respond or act. Often involves feeling embarrassed or troubled by an unexpected situation.

examples.japanese: {困惑|こんわく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{告白|こくはく}→告白：06742_kokuhaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{困惑|こんわく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was bewildered by his sudden confession.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予想外|よそうがい}→予想外：03188_yosougai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{困惑|こんわく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦{答|こた}えられなかった→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: Confused by the unexpected question, I couldn't answer well.

notes:
USAGE: Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form the verb {困惑|こんわく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be bewildered, to be confused).

NUANCE: {困惑|こんわく} implies being at a loss about how to respond to an unexpected or awkward situation. It often involves an element of social discomfort or embarrassment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {困惑|こんわく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be bewildered/confused)
- {困惑|こんわく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧/⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (bewildered expression/face)
- {困惑|こんわく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}せない→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧ (unable to hide one's confusion)
- {困惑|こんわく}⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧ (somewhat bewildered)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{当惑|とうわく}→当惑：16723_touwaku⟧ (confusion, perplexity - very similar)
- ⟦{戸惑|とまど}う→戸惑う：06036_tomadou⟧ (to be confused, bewildered)
- ⟦{途方|とほう}に{暮|く}れる→途方に暮れる：17548_tohounikureru⟧ (to be at a loss)
- ⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧ (confusion - more about disorder)
